question: A magnetic needle is placed in a non-uniform magnetic field. Describe the forces and torques acting on it.

options.A: It experiences a net force but no torque.
options.B: It experiences a torque but no net force.
options.C: It experiences both a net force and a torque.
options.D: It experiences neither a force nor a torque.
